products.name: SASE / SSE Architecture & Design Blueprint — Commercial
products.short_description: A SASE/SSE architecture and design blueprint — a coherent reference design tying SWG, ZTNA, CASB, SSL inspection, and identity-based policy into one operating model, with a phased adoption roadmap. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Design your SASE/SSE architecture once — and roll out every edge service against one blueprint

Organizations buy SASE/SSE capabilities piecemeal — a web gateway here, ZTNA there — and end up with overlapping, inconsistent, hard-to-operate edge security. This solution delivers a SASE/SSE architecture and design blueprint: a coherent reference design that ties together secure web gateway, Zero Trust network access, cloud app control (CASB), SSL inspection, and identity-based policy into one operating model, with a phased adoption roadmap.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the SASE/SSE model, the component services (SWG, ZTNA, CASB, SSL inspection, DLP) and how they fit, identity as the control plane, and the target operating model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a Netskope tenant and licensed modules, Entra ID identity, endpoint management, network/egress design inputs, executive sponsorship) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: assess current state and inventory edge services, define the reference architecture and policy model, set the phased adoption roadmap, establish operating-model roles and KPIs, run a pilot phase, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — current-state edge/identity discovery, architecture-readiness validation, a capability-coverage and gap report, safe remediation of configuration gaps, and a phase-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

One coherent SASE/SSE architecture — SWG, ZTNA, CASB, SSL inspection, and identity policy designed as a single operating model with a phased roadmap — replacing piecemeal edge security, proven on a pilot phase before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SASE-Discovery.ps1 — Read-only current-state edge/identity inventory for a SASE/SSE design
    • SASE-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation of SASE/SSE readiness gaps (default -WhatIf)
    • SASE-Report.ps1 — Read-only capability-coverage + gap report and operating-model KPI view
    • SASE-Set-PhaseScopeTargeting.ps1 — Phase-scope targeting-group builder (default -WhatIf)
    • SASE-Validation.ps1 — Read-only architecture-readiness validation for a SASE/SSE rollout

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
